jobs.title: Platform Program Manager, AMP Partner Operations
jobs.description:
Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners\-spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators\-through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches \- knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration. ","responsibilities":"You will own the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle for new platform features and major partner launches. Your core responsibilities include:  

  

Platform Capability \& Feature Onboarding  

  

Drive Partner Adoption of Platform Capabilities: Lead the operational rollout and partner adoption for emerging features to our billing platform.  

  

Partner with product and engineering teams to establish operational readiness for novel subscription bundling models (e.g., streaming and carrier bundles), tier upgrades/downgrades via update\-entitlement APIs, and multi\-country configurations.  

  

Define Migration \& Sunset Flows (CIP to Direct): Own the Partner Ops workstream for transitioning subscribers between partner\-billed and Apple\-direct models, defining end\-to\-end operational requirements, PVT validation flows, and subscription cancellation/revocation procedures.  

  

Technical Operations  

  

Lead Production Verification \& Testing Strategy: Partner with Commerce QA and Central Marketing UAT to define and execute comprehensive PVT plans; coordinate partner dependencies, including test SIM sourcing, test accounts, and allowlisting.  

  

Investigate Discrepancies \& Resolve Blockers: Triage operational and technical blockers impacting partner launches (e.g., deep\-link localization/offer sheet display issues, tax ID formatting on partner invoicing, missing commerce signals, and account unlinking edge cases).  

  

Operational Infrastructure \& Scalability  

  

Oversee intake trackers from the partner ops team and roadmap requests for platform enhancements; prioritize requests with engineering and product teams to balance partner velocity with long\-term platform health.  

  

Standardize Governance \& Enablement: Partner with regional teams (AMR, EMEIA, APAC) and integrators to deliver consistent integration best practices, partner capability trackers, and onboarding toolkits.  

  

Drive Process Automation: Identify manual intervention points across the onboarding lifecycle and work cross\-functionally to transition them into automated, self\-serve, and scalable tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.  

  

8\+ years of relevant industry experience in technical program management, partner operations, or systems integration.  

  

Experience in telecommunications carrier billing, digital streaming services (OTT/SVOD), or digital commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

8\+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner\-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back\-end platform capabilities.  

  

Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API\-driven partner integrations  

  

Proven track record in end\-to\-end partner onboarding \& operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).  

  

Strong cross\-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.  

  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back\-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data\-flow discrepancies across multi\-party ecosystems.  

  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner\-facing integration guides, and managing multi\-stakeholder operational reviews.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,700 and $225,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and emplo

jobs.description:
Kitchell seeks an experienced and dedicated **Senior** **Project Manager** to join our **Bay Area** region in the **City of** **San Francisco** and build a long\-term career at one of the most innovative and growth\-oriented building companies in the United States.

  




*Experience with Design Build Delivery method is strong preferred. Project scope is a parking structure. The client is in the Community College Market Sector with other ongoing projects under DSA oversight.*

  




**Responsibilities**


* Providing PM/CM Consultant Services as an Owner’s Representative over a ground\-up parking structure (Future project scope will be in the higher education market sector)
* Ensures operations are executed in accordance with company project management procedures and policies
* ensures delivery and adherence to contractual requirements and that all aspects of owner contracts are accomplished
* Manage the procurement phase and development of RFQs and RFPs
* Oversight of contracts, drawings, estimates, and specifications to ensure relation and compliance to project requirements
* Coordinate, direct, and monitor activities of contractors/subcontractors, engineers, architects, and related performing entities
* Manage project controls, cost, schedule, performance activities, and procedures required by the client
* Identifies and manages risk on the project, and advises and confers with regional executive prior to implementing risk mitigation actions
* Actively participates on internal teams that focus on continuous improvement of the company
* Ensures workplace health and safety policies and procedures are clearly communicated and understood by direct reports and enforces rules fairly and uniformly

**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline is preferred
* 12 or more years of experience as a Construction or Project Manager in the Construction industry is required
* Experience in the Education/Division of the State Architect (DSA) market is required
* Experience with an Integrated Project Delivery method such as Design\-Build as well as traditional Design Bid\-build method is strongly preferred

  




**Knowledge and Skills**


* Effective presentation skills, ability to develop and deliver presentations to the end users, stakeholders, board of education is required
* Proficient user skills with the MS Suite of tools and Bluebeam is required
* Working knowledge of standard industry tools such as P6 and Procore is strongly preferred
* Effective verbal and written communication skills to foster and maintain interpersonal relationships is required
* Provide leadership and financial management support to the project team is required

  


**License and Certifications**

* A valid driver’s license with an acceptable motor vehicle record, free from suspensions or restrictions is required
* A Certified Construction Manager (CCM) credential, a Design Build Institute of America (DBIA) certification, AND/OR a LEED Professional Accreditation is strongly preferred

  


**Travel Requirements**



Position is project site based in the City of San Francisco.

  


**Work Environment**



While performing the duties of this job, the employee must regularly work in an office, an office trailer, and/or in a construction jobsite environment. Conditions regularly include exposure to outdoor elements, hot/cold temperatures, wet conditions, noise, atmospheric conditions, and cramped quarters. The noise level in the work environment is occasionally loud.

  




**Physical Requirements**



While performing the duties of this job, the employee must regularly sit, stand, walk, talk or hear and use hands to finger, feel and handle; frequently reach with hands and arms; occasionally climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Must frequently lift and or move 10 pounds and occasionally lift and or move up to 50 pounds.

**ABOUT OUR COMPANY**



Founded in 1950, Kitchell began as a commercial contracting business and over the years developed new talents and enterprises, acquiring complementary businesses and expertise to remain competitive. Today, Kitchell Corporation serves as the holding entity for several companies that are integral to Kitchell's core business, as well as those that operate independently. We provide a wide range of services within the built environment, including general contracting, construction management, development, facilities management, engineering, architecture, and myriad other services. Our employees manage projects from our main offices located in Arizona, California, and Texas. We offer an entrepreneurial environment that fosters personal and professional growth through in\-house education programs, formal and informal mentoring, and cross\-training opportunities. At Kitchell, we prioritize internal growth and building careers from within. We consistently rank among the top places to work, thanks to our tenured staff and outstanding benefits that are designed to enrich our employees’ physical, mental, emotional, and financial well\-being. These benefits include company performance bonuses, discretionary stock options, incentive bonuses, health, and life insurance, health savings accounts (HSA) with wellness incentives, flexible spending accounts (FSA), 401(k) plans with a 4% company match, tuition reimbursement, weight loss programs, discounted auto insurance, identity theft protection, rewards programs, and much more.

  


*Kitchell is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.*

* Drive integration of new product, customer, and business unit requirements into VAS strategies, operating models, and execution frameworks
* Identify and advance opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and business impact across the VAS portfolio through process, governance, and tool enhancements
* Partner across GOQ, Business Units, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other key stakeholders to align priorities, improve visibility, and strengthen execution discipline
* Develop executive\-ready materials and insights for program reviews, stakeholder updates, and decision forums to support alignment, prioritization, and strategic action

### **About Northbeam**



Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. We're looking for a Technical Implementation Specialist to own the hands\-on onboarding and technical setup of new customers. You'll work directly with customers to configure the product, integrate data sources, and get them to first value as quickly and smoothly as possible.

Customer Onboarding \& Implementation

Project Management

Internal Collaboration

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field

* Bonus: experience with analytics, martech, data platforms, or attribution tools


\#LI\-Remote

The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**Project Manager, Configuration Management**



We're looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented PLM Analyst I to help keep the product data and engineering\-change processes behind our spacecraft moving quickly and accurately. This is an excellent entry\-level opportunity for someone who enjoys structured technical work, thrives on solving operational puzzles, and wants a front\-row seat to how complex hardware is designed, released, built, and improved.



You'll work closely with our PLM team and partners across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality. Your core focus will be managing the intake, entry, routing, and quality review of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), helping ensure that every change to our hardware is documented, reviewed, traceable, and ready for execution.



By owning these essential day\-to\-day workflows, you'll help scale the systems and processes that enable Astranis to build satellites faster and more reliably.


**Role**


* Create, enter, maintain, and track Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and associated PLM records
* Review ECO submissions for completeness, accuracy, required documentation, and adherence to established naming, revision\-control, and release standards
* Coordinate ECO routing, approvals, and follow\-up across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and other cross\-functional teams
* Proactively identify stalled, incomplete, or inconsistent change requests and work with stakeholders to keep them moving
* Support the release and revision of parts, assemblies, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and related engineering documentation
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics for ECO throughput, backlog, cycle time, and data quality


**Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, information systems, or another related technical field—or equivalent relevant experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to perform high\-accuracy, process\-driven work.
* Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, and technical documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize effectively, and follow defined
* processes.
* A collaborative approach and comfort working with technical and operational stakeholders.
* Curiosity about how physical products are designed, documented, released, and built.


**Bonus**


* Professional experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality, or configuration\-management teams.
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLM), enterprise resource planning (ERP), document\-control, ticketing, or workflow\-management systems.
* Exposure to engineering drawings, BOMs, part numbers, revisions, or change\-control processes.
* Interest in aerospace, satellites, or complex hardware development.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Epicus Group is a professional project and construction management firm providing owner’s representative consulting services, including workplace strategy, capital program planning, and facilities management. Our work spans the Life Sciences, Energy, and Government sectors, where we deliver comprehensive management and advisory services. We serve as an unbiased advocate for our clients, providing leadership and strategic guidance to navigate complex real estate challenges while minimizing risk and maximizing outcomes.

As we continue to expand our portfolio of exciting projects in Northern California, we are seeking a passionate Project Manager to join our growing team and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. This role will lead a large Life Science capital project as the owner’s representative on behalf of a client in Redwood City, bringing comprehensive knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulatory requirements.

The Project Manager will build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as the central point of contact for both internal stakeholders and external partners. You will lead efforts to streamline communication, drive strategic decision\-making, and optimize the performance of the client’s real estate assets. If you excel in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, possess a strategic mindset, and are passionate about delivering exceptional results while shaping the future of a growing business, we invite you to join Epicus Group.

**Your Role:** 

As a Project Manager, you will interface with Epicus clients and project teams through a successful process of strategic real estate planning, design, and construction of new buildings, tenant improvement buildouts, and facilities assignments. Some of the ways you will support our projects are:

* Lead and manage all phases of life science capital projects, including planning, design, construction, and close\-out, ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and schedule.
* Oversee stakeholder engagement, needs assessments, qualitative program reviews, business case development, and entitlement management to define and verify project goals and objectives.
* Serve as the primary liaison between clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and city officials, fostering strong partnerships and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead procurement efforts for design, construction, peer reviews, and specialty consultant services, including drafting scopes, evaluating proposals, negotiating contracts, and authorizing contract execution and purchase orders.
* Take the lead in preparing and implementing the project execution plan, project kick\-off activities, meetings, presentations, and ongoing project communications to ensure alignment with client objectives and company goals.
* Manage the design and construction phases, including oversight of architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, contractor coordination, and agency approvals to ensure program, budget, and schedule conformance.
* Provide high\-level construction administration and coordination, including oversight of meetings, progress reporting, RFIs, submittals, cost control, schedule management, FF\&E coordination, and contractor performance.
* Direct and continuously monitor project budgets and schedules using web\-based project controls; perform meaningful financial and schedule analysis and proactively identify and resolve potential risks, changes, or impacts.
* Organize and evaluate value engineering alternatives in collaboration with owners and design teams to support financial and performance objectives.
* Manage all aspects of project administration, including resource planning, contract compliance, forecasting, invoicing, progress draw reviews, issue resolution, and strategic decision\-making.
* Oversee architects’ review of contractor and vendor onsite activities to verify compliance with contractual documents, design intent, schedules, and workmanship standards.
* Observe and report on construction activities and construction\-related issues, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.
* Establish, lead, and document project meetings; clearly communicate project status, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
* Motivate, mentor, and direct internal project teams (Assistant Project Managers and Project Managers), ensuring accountability, performance development, and achievement of project milestones.
* Oversee the project close\-out process, ensuring all deliverables, documentation, financial reconciliation, and contractual requirements are completed successfully.
* Drive business development efforts, including leading RFQ/RFP responses, proposal development, presentations, interviews, and contract negotiations, and ensuring a seamless transition from business development to project execution.
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand presence and support business development initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 4 years of project management experience within the Life Science sector.
* Bachelor’s or associate degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, business, or related field.
* Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM) or LEED AP is desired.
* Experience in the Northern California market, having strong relationships with clients, design firms, general contractors, and stakeholders
* Knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulations, from programming, entitlement and design through construction and operations.
* Highly motivated, ambitious and demonstrated business acumen, with a track record of exceeding targets. Expert at building relationships and earning trust.
* Detail\-oriented and analytical, excellent communication skills, strong organization and time management skills,

jobs.title: AV Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.



Flexdrive, Lyft's wholly\-owned fleet management subsidiary, is undergoing a transformational shift from traditional rideshare fleet operations to autonomous vehicle fleet ownership and operations. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross\-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.



This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross\-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. You will work closely with workstream leads across Operations, Strategy, Infrastructure, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and People.



If you thrive in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex multi\-workstream programs, and have a bias toward action, this role is for you.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


### **1\. Program Planning \& Execution**


* Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal.
* Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross\-functional blockers with clear context for escalation.
* Support weekly leadership syncs and monthly deep\-dive reviews, including preparation, presentation and follow\-through.
* Translate upstream decisions (partner agreements, market selections, ) into operational requirements, updating the readiness roadmap accordingly.

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Serve as a connection point between workstream leads, helping ensure infrastructure timelines align with hiring plans, capital deployment schedules match construction milestones, and fleet operations readiness tracks to vehicle delivery dates.
* Act as the central hub across cross\-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution
* Coordinate with People and Operations to help sequence hiring, training, and certification programs ahead of vehicle arrivals.
* Work with FP\&A and Treasury to track investment spend against the capital deployment schedule and flag variance early.

### **3\. Stakeholder Communication \& Reporting**


* Build and deliver clear status reporting to program leadership and workstream stakeholders.
* Ensure cross\-functional stakeholders stay aligned on expectations, deliverables, and timelines throughout the program.
* Maintain market readiness scorecards that provide visibility into each market's progress against deployment milestones.
* Create and maintain program documentation including decision logs, meeting notes, and workstream status trackers.

### **4\. Process Support \& Operational Excellence**


* Help design and implement the program management operating model for AV readiness
* Identify and build process improvements across workstreams, using data to help optimize timelines and resource allocation.
* Build repeatable playbooks for market readiness that scale

**Experience:**
---------------


* 5 years of experience in program management, business operations, or a similar cross\-functional role, ideally within high\-growth tech, fleet management, logistics, or infrastructure\-heavy environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate operational detail into clear updates for cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple workstreams, and adapting whatever program management tools or frameworks the situation calls for
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve
* Strong relationship\-building skills, with the ability to organize effective working groups and resolve conflicts around program processes and goals.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, quantify trade\-offs, and recommend courses of action with imperfect information.
* **Preferred**
	+ Experience preparing materials for and presenting to senior leaders
	+ Experience with infrastructure buildout programs (depot construction, facility standup, real estate development).
	+ Background in capital intensive projects, fleet management, automotive, mobility, or autonomous vehicle operations.
	+ Experience managing programs that span domestic and international markets.
	+ Experience in a subsidiary or business unit operating within a larger corporate parent.

-------------

* Family building benefits

jobs.description:
**What the Role Is**



As the CS Enablement Program Manager, you'll be the business owner of the systems that make both our human agents and AI agents effective, starting with the quality and integrity of the knowledge they rely on. As a highly autonomous, high\-judgment IC, you'll build and continuously improve the knowledge base, SOPs, training, and AI\-powered workflows that underpin Customer Support across Babylist and Babylist Health. You'll bring deep operational rigor and a strong understanding of how AI is changing customer support—using the technology in your own work while designing systems that make it more effective across the organization. This is a greenfield opportunity to build the CS Enablement function at a tech\-first consumer company: identifying where knowledge, policies, and workflows break down, and partnering across CS, BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics to build a support system that gets smarter and more reliable as we scale.


**Who You Are**


* **Deep expertise in Support Operations, Enablement, or Knowledge Management**: you've owned documentation, workflows, and operational strategy in high\-volume environments.
* **Can build and manage a knowledge base from scratch** (Zendesk, Gladly, Help Scout, Notion, Guru, or similar), organizing content and maintaining accuracy at scale so both humans and AI systems can use it effectively.
* **Can design for a hybrid AI\-agent and human\-agent support organization**: structuring content for AI consumption, writing effective prompts, evaluating output quality, and calling the line between what's automated and what stays human\-owned.
* **Can write clear, usable SOPs** for complex, multi\-step, or edge\-case scenarios, and know when to automate them instead.
* **Can build and deliver training that actually changes how people work**: onboarding, process rollouts, tool adoption, AI workflow enablement.
* **Strong analytical instincts**: you can read support data (ticket trends, contact drivers, resolution times) and turn it into decisions about what to fix, automate, or rebuild.
* **Comfortable being the first person to do this job.** This space doesn't have an established playbook in customer support yet, you'll be creating it.
* **Effective cross\-functional partner** who can work with BizOps, Product, Analytics, and engineering\-adjacent teams to drive real change, not just executing within your own lane.
* **Demonstrated track record of using AI to do your own work better**. At Babylist every team uses AI daily. You're already using it daily to move faster and improve your output, and have real opinions about when it works and when it doesn't.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Build the CS Enablement program from the ground up: create the systems that keep agents (human and AI) current on knowledge base, training, and copilot content as product changes accelerate.
* Move support operations from AI\-assisted to AI\-native: rebuild workflows, documentation, and training so AI is the default operating model.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base that serves as the source of truth for both AI systems and human agents, structured for AI consumption and kept accurate as products and policies evolve.
* Close existing content gaps and continuously identify how to reduce unnecessary escalations and drive meaningful improvement in chatbot coverage and resolution rate.
* Lead the implementation of an AI copilot and bring usage to 90%\+ of agent interactions by making the copilot genuinely useful (better source material, better prompt design).
* Build agent confidence through scalable training that teaches people when to trust AI, when to override it, and how to give feedback that improves it.
* Create SOPs for complex scenarios so cases get handled consistently, audit and streamline fragmented workflows, and design new processes with AI built in from the start.
* Partner with the CS Analyst to identify top contact drivers and documentation gaps, then act on them.
* Establish feedback loops with frontline agents so the system keeps improving instead of just when someone notices a problem.


**Why This Role**


* **You'd be defining a role that doesn't have a template yet.** "AI\-native CS enablement" isn't an established discipline in customer support. You won't be applying someone else's playbook, you'll be writing it.
* **The foundation is still forming, and that's the opportunity.** Most of the knowledge base, SOPs, and AI workflows don't exist yet, so the systems you build become how the org operates for years.
* **You'll have real influence on the roadmap, not just execution against it.** You're setting the agenda with BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics on what gets fixed, automated, and rebuilt next.
* **Your success is directly visible in the numbers that matter to the business**: chatbot deflection, copilot adoption, CSAT. This isn't a support role in the background, it's core to how CS scales.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$140,000 to $170,000**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

jobs.title: Sr Professional Services Strategy & Ops Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **About the role:**


The Moveworks Professional Services team deploys agentic AI for some of the largest enterprises in the world. As we scale delivery across a fast\-growing partner ecosystem, we're hiring a Services Delivery Operations Manager to own the day\-to\-day operational backbone that keeps our implementation and ongoing services engagements running smoothly.


This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports — a high\-ownership, high\-autonomy seat for an operator who can run the machine (PSA administration, staffing, capacity, partner subcontracting, and partner program intake) so that Services leadership can stay focused on broader strategy and scale. You will be the connective tissue across Professional Services and our delivery partners, and the person the team trusts to keep delivery operations humming.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Administer and optimize Rocketlane PSA: Act as the operational owner for Rocketlane configuration, project setup, user onboarding, workflow hygiene, and closed/won\-to\-project handoffs; troubleshoot issues quickly and improve system usability, data quality, and adoption across the delivery organization.
* Lead services resource management: Run the operating cadence for staffing, capacity planning, utilization visibility, and backlog alignment across implementation and ongoing services work; connect pipeline, bookings, project demand, skill requirements, and delivery capacity to recommend assignments, identify coverage gaps, and inform subcontractor needs before they impact customer outcomes.
* Coordinate partner and subcontractor delivery operations: Run the operating process for partner\-subcontracted delivery, from intake and assignment through onboarding, execution tracking, issue resolution, and process improvement.
* Streamline partner program intake: Manage partner program submissions and operational requests with clear SLAs, clean handoffs, and consistent follow\-through so onboarding and engagement readiness move without friction.
* Build operational reporting and delivery insights: Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and exception reports that give Services leadership actionable visibility into delivery health, utilization, forecast accuracy, partner performance, and process bottlenecks.
* Improve scalable operating rhythms: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner teams to standardize workflows, close operational gaps, and enable a repeatable delivery model as the business grows.

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience applying AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve operating workflows, decision support, reporting, or productivity within a services, operations, or customer\-facing function.
* 3–5 years in Professional Services Operations, Revenue Operations, Partner Operations, PMO operations, or a related SaaS delivery operations role.
* Hands\-on proficiency with PSA, CRM, or project delivery systems; Rocketlane experience is strongly preferred, with Kantata, Certinia/FinancialForce, Salesforce, or comparable platforms also valuable.
* Working knowledge of SaaS Professional Services metrics such as utilization, capacity, backlog, attach rate, forecast accuracy, delivery health, and services margin.
* Background supporting partner\-led or subcontracted delivery models, including intake, onboarding, assignment coordination, operational governance, and process improvement.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize data from multiple systems, identify trends, and convert findings into practical recommendations for Services leaders.
* Process\-oriented operator who can design lightweight workflows, document repeatable practices, drive adoption, and iterate quickly as the delivery model evolves.
* High ownership and sound judgment in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments; able to make progress independently, escalate thoughtfully, and balance speed with operational discipline.
* Clear communicator and trusted cross\-functional partner who can align Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans.

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Center Investments and Development
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in technology, infrastructure development, real estate investment, or management consulting environments.
* Experience designing and running organizational rhythms, including OKR/KPI setting, Annual Operating Plans (AOP), Long\-Range Capacity Plans, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Experience eliminating multi\-stakeholder approval bottlenecks, and establish standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Analytical background in maintaining clean, auditable agreement databases (e.g., Salesforce, custom pipeline trackers, GIS databases) to empower leadership with actionable business intelligence.
* Familiarity with commercial real estate agreement structures, land acquisition due diligence, colocation/wholesale leasing, zoning, environmental reviews, and utility interconnection timelines.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments, unblocking urgent deadlocks.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Development Pipeline and Business Operation (DPBO) team supports land acquisitions and data center leasing through data integrity oversight, development of standard operating procedures, policies and best practices, and deployment of AI tools aimed at streamlining the agreement flow. Members of the team contribute at each milestone, from site selection/intake/origination, through approvals, on to asset management. As markets shift, and business needs evolve, DPBO is at the frontline, adjusting course so the greater Data Center Investments and Development (DCID) team can respond.


DPBO also serves as the connective tissue between DCID and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities. This gives DPBO a birds\-eye view of the entire data center life\-cycle, allowing team members to develop high\-leverage expertise across acquisitions, contracting, technology and business operations.


As the Operations and Strategic Program Manager for the DCID Public Affairs Manager team, you will serve as the backbone and strategic team multiplier to ensure Google's license to operate. Navigating the critical intersection of programmatic management, strategy, communications, and business operations, you will assist the organization’s business cadence, including program management and delivery, contract management, OKRs, quarterly business reviews, yearly budgeting, and executive communications. You will partner closely with leadership and organizational stakeholders to establish standard operating procedures, govern data integrity, and design frictionless approval workflows. Additionally, you will represent DCID across technical, financial, and real estate teams, as you ensure seamless cross\-functional alignment, elevate data\-driven decision\-making, foster continuous organizational learning across the data center delivery lifecycle and ensure strategic priorities are translated into scalable operational frameworks.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide operational and programmatic support for public affairs managers, tasked with leading local engagement around data center investments and development, including, but not limited to: contract management, drafting of program charters, budget tracking and financial compliance, and pipeline reporting.
* Serve as an articulate, credible ambassador representing Google in select public forums, civic engagements, and community stakeholder panels.
* Work with leadership to craft internal, organization\-wide communications, bridge communication gaps between functional silos (e.g., Engineer, Finance, Legal, BizOps), manage leadership communications, and plan organization\-wide meetings and learning opportunities.
* Compile, organize and present programmatic metrics to leadership, and serve as point person for organization\-wide directives, such as OKRs, yearly budgets and quarterly business reviews.
* Serve as the connective tissue between DCID/PAMs and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


Oura is looking for a Packaging Program Manager to lead the development and delivery of packaging across new product introduction and sustaining initiatives. This role drives cross\-functional execution from concept through mass production, ensuring packaging solutions meet product, brand, cost, quality, sustainability, regulatory, and supply chain requirements.


The ideal candidate brings strong program management discipline, strong packaging development experience, and the ability to align highly cross\-functional teams around clear plans, decisions, risks, and milestones. They operate comfortably in fast\-moving hardware environments and know how to balance customer experience, operational readiness, and business goals.


This is role is based in San Francisco.


**What you will do:**


* Lead end\-to\-end packaging program execution for new product development, special editions, and sustaining changes from concept through launch and post\-launch support.
* Build and manage integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and decision logs for packaging deliverables across engineering, operations, and commercial teams.
* Partner across Packaging Engineering, Product Management, Design, Hardware Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Creative, and Marketing to align technical, business, and brand requirements.
* Translate product, technical, and brand requirements into executable packaging plans and drive packaging readiness through development gates, validation builds, ramp, and launch.
* Own cross\-functional coordination of key packaging technical deliverables, including structure, materials, artwork, labeling, specifications, tooling, pack\-out, and supplier feasibility.

* Ensure packaging solutions meet the product requirements including protection, reliability, regulatory, sustainability, cost, manufacturability, distribution, and customer unboxing experience.

* Identify packaging program and technical risks early, drive mitigation plans to closure, and coordinate external partners and suppliers to deliver materials, tooling, specifications, and logistics on time.
* Track cost, quality, schedule, readiness, and technical maturity metrics, and manage the overall packaging tracker to improve packaging materials, waste reduction, regulatory alignment, and execution discipline.

**Qualifications:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or packaging program managemen**t** in consumer electronics, hardware, or related physical product environments.
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional programs from concept through production ramp and launch.
* Strong understanding of packaging development processes, validation milestones, tooling, artwork release, supplier readiness, and manufacturing execution.

* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to present clear status, risks, and recovery plans.
* Experience working with external vendors, contract manufacturers, and global supply chain partners.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and sound judgment in ambiguous environments.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and effective at driving accountability across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting premium consumer products with high brand and customer experience expectations.
* Experience with sustainable packaging strategy and execution.
* Familiarity with manufacturing builds, NPI processes, and go\-to\-market readiness for hardware products.
* Experience partnering with creative, brand, and industrial design teams on packaging development.

* Packaging programs hit major milestones with clear ownership and predictable execution.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security Risk Program
jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Security Risk Program Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Meta's AI Launch Risk Assessment framework end to end — intake criteria, cross\-domain risk taxonomy, assessment methodology, and launch\-gate outputs — and scale delivery from \~5 to 20\+ assessments per quarter by H1 2027\.
* Build and partner to manage the XFN operating model that coordinates Central Security, product groups, Privacy Risk Management, Integrity Risk Management, and Legal through each assessment, with clear roles, handoffs, and decision rights on a launch timeline.
* Partner directly with product and engineering teams on high\-priority AI launches — engaging early enough that security risk review informs design decisions rather than gating release, and giving product teams a predictable, well\-documented path through second\-line review.
* Serve as the connection point between the Security Risk Program, Central Security leadership, Legal, and first\-line business teams, representing security risk positions and negotiating assessment scope, sequencing, and remediation commitments.
* Build and maintain a consolidated AI risk register that gives leadership a single view of.
* security risk across the AI product portfolio, and produce the reporting that keeps that view current for VP and executive audiences.
* Define tooling requirements and drive AI\-enabled automation across the assessment lifecycle — identifying where automation can scale throughput without compromising assessment defensibility, and partnering with tooling and engineering owners to deliver it.
* Ensure assessments and supporting artifacts are produced to internal standards, are.
* submission\-ready, and constitute defensible evidence of systematic security due diligence for regulators and auditors (including EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF expectations).
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers across the program, define mitigation plans, monitor key delivery and SLA metrics, and drive corrective action with stakeholders when performance deviates.
* Create and facilitate presentations that build senior leadership understanding and influence decision\-making, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on program design and assessment practice.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in governance, risk, and compliance, security risk management,
* Regulatory compliance, or a directly related discipline
* 2\+ years of program management experience in a corporate environment
* Experience with risk and compliance precepts, practices, and solutions
* Experience designing a program or process from the ground up — not solely running an established one — including methodology, operating model, and rollout
* Experience driving cross\-functional alignment across technical and non\-technical partners without direct authority, including with engineering or product organizations
* Proven verbal and written communication skills, with success influencing a range of audiences including senior leadership

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience assessing or managing risk for AI or machine learning systems, or familiarity with AI\-specific regulatory and risk frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF)
* Experience embedding risk, security, or compliance review into a fast\-moving product
* Development lifecycle and launch process
* Experience working in information security and/or cybersecurity
* Experience partnering with a central security or infrastructure security

jobs.title: Localization Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Localization Program Manager to help drive the next evolution of Localization at Meta: applying AI and automation to transform how our programs operate. You will own and drive localization programs across product lines, leveraging AI tools as a force multiplier to deliver localization at greater scale, speed, and quality. You will partner closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure localized products reach global users — contributing to Meta's mission to connect people across languages and cultures.  

  

  

### **Localization Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive localization programs across assigned product lines, identifying where existing workflows fall short and implementing AI\-powered improvements to increase scale and efficiency
* Navigate ambiguity in evolving product and AI landscapes — proactively identifying localization risks and unsolved problems, escalating effectively, and driving resolution across cross\-functional partners
* Leverage AI tools and automation as a force multiplier to redesign localization workflows, automating repetitive tasks and accelerating time\-to\-market across language markets
* Evaluate and prioritize localization work within your program areas by assessing business impact, aligning with cross\-functional partners on what to focus on, and ensuring resources are directed toward the highest\-value opportunities
* Build consensus and drive alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Content Design, Legal, Regional Growth) to drive product team adoption of standardized localization workflows, reducing ad\-hoc support and enabling the team to scale
* Communicate program status, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross\-functional partners and leadership, proactively surfacing tradeoffs and providing structured updates that enable informed decision\-making
* Coach and influence peers and partners on modern localization practices, building organizational capability by helping teams internalize how to build internationalization into their products and workflows from inception

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in localization or equivalent program management, internationalization, or international product growth within a technology company
* Experience managing cross\-functional localization programs spanning multiple product lines, languages, and regional markets
* Experience operationalizing localization strategy, including vendor management, quality frameworks, and integration of localization into product development lifecycles
* Experience using data and metrics to inform program decisions and communicate priorities to stakeholders
* Experience navigating cross\-functional dependencies and driving alignment across product, engineering, and content teams
* Experience applying AI\-powered translation technologies or use of AI to improve efficiency and quality at scale

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting international product growth in emerging or high\-complexity language markets, including right\-to\-left languages or markets with significant linguistic variation
* Familiarity with internationalization engineering concepts such as Unicode handling, locale\-specific formatting, and string externalization that affect localization feasibility
* Experience establishing or contributing to localization standards adopted across multiple teams or product areas

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID\-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.  

  



Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life\-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.  

  



We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
  

  

**Job Description**  



**Job Responsibilities:**

* Performs a wide variety of activities to ensure compliance with applicable quality objectives and regulatory requirements \- supervises QA personnel, including organizing and prioritizing daily tasks, performing training, and writing performance reviews.
* Participates in writing or suggesting changes to controlled documents (e.g., SOPs, specifications, methods, etc.) as needed to ensure defined quality objectives are met.
* Maintains programs and processes to ensure high quality products and compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLPs).
* Reviews manufacturing, environmental monitoring and quality control data for in\-process and finished products.
* Works closely with operating entities to ensure that inspections, statistical process control analyses and audits are conducted on a continuing basis, to enforce requirements and meet specifications.
* May participate in the writing of annual product reviews and the development of training programs regarding all aspects of producing quality products.
* May conduct or serve as a lead/coordinator of investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) recommendations related to manufactured products.
* Works with Research and Development during new product start\-ups, and establishes key checkpoints for new products and processes.
* May assist or lead compliance audits as required. May interface with regulatory agencies as required.
Interfaces with contract manufacturers to address documentation and compliance issues.  
* 

**Basic Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of relevant experience in a GMP environment related field and a BS or BA.
5\+ years of relevant experience and a MS.  
* 

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Proficient in GMPs and/or GLPs.
* Proficient in application of QA principles, concepts, industry practices, and standards.
* Demonstrates ability to effectively manage multiple projects/priorities.
* Has proven analytical and conceptual skills.
* Demonstrates understanding of international quality systems regulations to adopt best in class systems/processes
* Demonstrates excellent verbal communication, technical writing and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrates working knowledge and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Knowledge of Six Sigma, Define\-Measure\-Analyze\-Improve\-Control (DMAIC) methodology, performance measures and quality improvement statistical is beneficial.
Working knowledge of Risk Management tools (e.g., Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and / or Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)) is beneficial.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch under the supervision of the Program Manager \- BIH, provides on\-site supervision to children ages 1 month to 12 years while parents attend prenatal, postpartum, and/or other BIH related group activities. Knowledge of appropriate child development theories and practices. Ability to create and maintain a safe learning environment for children. Ability to work effectively with children, parents, and program staff. Effective oral and written communication skills; sensitive to the needs of small children. May work up to 20 hours per week as needed for program demands

**QUALIFICATIONS:** 

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent. A typical way of obtaining the knowledge, skills and abilities outlined above is completion of six (6\) units of early childhood education or child development (with a grade of “C” or better) from an accredited college/university; or 4 months of ROP Training in a Child Development Program.
* Certification: Certification in Infant and Pediatric CPR and First Aid must be met within 30 days of assignment. Must successfully pass the background check. NegativeTB test required upon hire and must be maintained every four (4\) years.
* Brand Ambassador: Ability to project a positive image to the public.
* Experience: At least one (1\) year of experience working as a childcare aide, teacher aide or higher position.
* Mental and Physical Skills: The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch occasionally is required to climb, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Frequently required to talk or hear. Ability to lift children up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus to view documents. Regularly required to use oral communication skills; read information and documents; solve problems; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with BIH program staff, participants (parents) and their children ages 1month – 12years.
* Interpersonal and Time Management Skills: Active listening, empathy, and cultural competence required. Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing in a professional manner. Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment, with rapidly shifting priorities and competing demands while maintaining attention to detail.
* Other: Ability to remain calm and courteous in a high stress environment. CHA / Child Watch should be able to work independently with minimal direction.

**Duties**

* Sets up child watch room/area prior to arrival of children.
* Assists in developing and maintaining a safe environment for children.
* Ensures that children engage in age\-appropriate activities/play (including watching of movies or videos);
* Provides emotional and physical support as appropriate to children and encourages high self\-esteem.
* Escorts of children who are toilet trained in the restroom and may change diapers for other children as needed.
* Supervises snack\-time (food to be provided by BIH program or child’s parent). Cleans up child watch room/area at the conclusion of child watch assignment.
* Other Duties as Assigned. Child Watch will attend and actively participate in training and care coordination meetings. This includes, but is not limited to, assisting with Black Infant Health Program events for BIH participants. .

**Requirements**

* Attends work regularly and punctually.
* Provides care appropriate to the age of the infants / children served.
* Works cooperatively with BIH Program Coordinator, Public Health Nurse, Mental Health Professional, Community Outreach Liaison, BIH staff members, and other Baywell Health staff persons, as required.
* Treats all participants / clients / visitors with respect and courtesy.
* Remains competent in skills required for position.
* During the initial thirty (30\) days of employment, becomes and remains knowledgeable about and in compliance with Baywell Health and Black Infant Health Program policies and procedures in the following areas:

a. Confidentiality of patient / participant / fellow employee and supplier records.

b. Professional and business ethics.

c. Continuous quality and improvement.

d. Safety and security of person and property.

e. Infection control.

f. Hazardous materials and waste.

g. Life safety and emergency preparedness.

Join us in creating healthier communities by empowering families through education, advocacy, and compassionate service! This paid role offers a rewarding environment where your efforts directly impact the well\-being of children and underserved populations alike.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No more than 20\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinician and Intensive Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM, BE THE DIFFERENCE!  


About the Role \| Why It's Exciting  


As a Clinician and Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC), you will provide evidence\-based therapy and coordinate comprehensive care for youth, caregivers, schools, and community providers. You will develop collaborative care plans that reflect each family's voice, strengthen relationships, and connect youth and families with the support they need. In this role, you will deliver high\-impact, community\-based behavioral health services in Contra Costa County for a respected nonprofit with more than 60 years of service to youth and families. Our collaborative, strengths\-based culture values your expertise, honors your lived experience, and actively supports your professional growth.  


What You Bring  


You're a compassionate clinician committed to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care. You bring clinical judgment, organizational excellence, and the ability to manage complex cases. We serve clients with broad and complex needs, so would prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:  


Complex trauma and attachment\-related challenges  


Autism Spectrum Disorder and neurodevelopmental conditions  


LGBTQ\+ affirming care and gender\-affirming practice  


Co\-occurring behavioral and physical health conditions  


Working with historically marginalized communities and addressing behavioral health disparities  


Bilingual English/Spanish skills are a plus and will be taken into consideration when factoring the overall compensation package, yet we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.  


Key Responsibilities  


Help Youth and Families Thrive  


Provide strengths\-based, trauma\-informed, and culturally responsive mental health care through comprehensive assessment, treatment planning, and individual and family therapy. Support youth and caregivers in building resilience, developing effective coping skills, strengthening family connections, and achieving meaningful treatment goals. Work with families from diverse cultural backgrounds and experiences.  


Lead Collaborative Care Coordination  


Facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and case conferences with caregivers, service providers, and educators. Guide collaborative decision\-making, ensure every voice is heard, and align treatment plans with each family's strengths and goals.  


Drive Lasting Outcomes  


Coordinate services among schools, behavioral health providers, child welfare agencies, and community partners to ensure that youth and families receive connected, culturally responsive, and trauma\-informed support.  


Maintain Quality Documentation  


Maintain timely, high\-quality clinical documentation and ensure compliance with Medi\-Cal, HIPAA, and agency standards.  


Why Youth Homes?  


At Youth Homes, clinicians are trusted partners, advocates, and leaders. We support and encourage your growth through:  


Individual and group clinical supervision at no cost (clinical hours count toward BBS Licensure)  


Dedicated professional development for licensed providers pursuing Clinical Director or supervisor roles  


Fully agency\-sponsored training opportunities in trauma\-informed and culturally responsive practice  


Annual training stipend  


Flexible scheduling with hybrid and remote work options  


Mileage reimbursement  


Generous PTO plus 9 paid holidays and birthday time\-off  


Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits  


Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health support  


Compensation \& Career Path  


Starting annual salary:$71,316 \- $78,447, based on experience and licensure status. Licensed clinicians may negotiate higher compensation based on credentials and background. Bilingual differential: $3,000 or more annually. Clear career pathways exist for clinicians interested in supervision, program development, or leadership roles.  


Required Qualifications  


Master's degree in social work, Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related field  


Current registration or licensure with the California Board of Behavioral Sciences (A/LMFT, A/LCSW, A/LPCC)  


Commitment to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care and strong clinical judgment, organizational skills, and ability to manage complex cases  


Other Requirements  


At least 21 years of age  


Successfully pass background checks, health screening and other licensing/certification requirements.  


Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license and personal auto insurance.  


If you are passionate about trauma\-informed, culturally responsive mental health care and ready to make a lasting impact in your community, we invite you to apply!  


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB): https://youthhomes.org/better\-together

jobs.title: Quality Assurance and Improvement ("QA/I") Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi\-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.  

The Quality Assurance and Improvement (“QA/I”) Program Manager provides direction to QA/I staff to ensure projects deliver desired results in a timely and efficient fashion. Ensures well\-established improvement models are used to achieve improvement in care delivery and patient experience. Participates in the development, implementation, and maintenance of QA/I programs and achievement of QA/I department goals and objectives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Under the leadership of the QA/I Director, identifies improvement opportunities that lead to achieving organizational strategic priorities. **Work Schedule:**
This role is primarily onsite, and candidates should be comfortable working in person on a regular basis.
Responsibilities:
* Manages QA/I project management staff as needed to support the goals of the department and the organization.
* Serves as primary project manager on complex, new initiatives that support MCC strategic priorities.
* Works to identify and support quality improvement priorities for the organization, as shaped by internal priorities and needs.
* Collaborates with Compliance and Risk teams, ensuring awareness of incidents and identified risks, and leading improvement projects to address risks.
* Develops and demonstrates advanced knowledge of quality improvement theory and strategy, as well as expertise on key quality oversight programs and agencies relevant to FQHCs, including but not limited to HRSA/UDS, HEDIS, Medi\-Cal, Joint Commission, etc.
* Collaborates with clinical and operational leaders, as well as QA/I staff, to continuously develop, evaluate and improve specific QA/I approaches to key clinical and operational quality metrics.
* Strives to make QA/I metrics, goals and strategies familiar, meaningful and actionable across the organization and to promote a “culture of quality” by engaging all staff in QI/A work, to the extent possible.
* In partnership with the Director of QA/I, supports the Quality Assurance and Quality Improvement (QAQI) Committee, including supporting monthly prep meetings to review performance and data with internal teams.
* Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
**Education and Experience:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Administration or a related field required (in cases of an unrelated degree, at least five years of related analytical or quality improvement experience will be accepted in lieu of a Healthcare\-related degree).
* Master’s Degree in a subject area related to Public Health strongly preferred.
* At least 5 years of related analytical or quality improvement experience required in a healthcare clinic setting.
* Management experience strongly desired.
* Experience working in a Federally Qualified Health Center strongly desired.
* Experience with complex project management required.
