jobs.description:
Our Customer Success team is committed to helping customers maximize the value of Asana as both a technology platform and a holistic approach to collaboration. From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time.



As a Manager, Customer Success (L7\), you will lead our Enterprise Accounts team, taking ownership of the health, growth, and strategic value delivery of our most critical enterprise customer relationships. Reporting to Customer Success leadership, you will coach and develop a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers, build scalable programs that drive adoption and AI consumption, and serve as a key cross\-functional partner across Sales, Product, and Enablement. You will bring people leadership, operational excellence, and customer obsession to drive AI\-driven transformation across our enterprise portfolio.



This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office\-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in\-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in\-office requirements.


### **What you'll achieve**


* **People Leadership \& Coaching:** Coach, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Enterprise CSMs through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning while defining goals, KPIs, and success metrics.
* **Executive Relationship Advisory:** Build and nurture executive\-level relationships with enterprise customers, serving as an escalation point, strategic advisor, and leader for executive business reviews.
* **Program \& Operational Scaling:** Design and launch scalable programs and operational frameworks to improve customer health, drive product adoption and AI consumption, and optimize retention across the enterprise portfolio.
* **Portfolio Risk \& Opportunity Management:** Identify, track, and mitigate churn risk while systematically surfacing and converting expansion opportunities.
* **Cross\-Functional Voice of Customer:** Partner closely with Sales on account strategy and collaborate with Product to capture product gaps, synthesize customer feedback, and influence the product roadmap.

### **About you**


* **Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision\-making.**
* 7\+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within Enterprise SaaS, with at least 2–3 years in a direct people leadership or team management role.
* Proven track record managing complex, high\-value enterprise accounts, with experience in the AI or ML space strongly preferred.
* Operationally minded leader capable of building, executing, and iterating on programs, playbooks, and processes at scale.
* Commanding executive presence with comfort navigating C\-suite relationships on behalf of your team and the organization.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience owning and reporting against key SaaS metrics, including GRR, NRR, and adoption KPIs.
* Exceptional cross\-functional communicator skilled at partnering across Sales, Product, and Enablement teams.


At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.


### **What we'll offer**



Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.



For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $238,000\-280,000\. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. jobs.title: Senior Compliance Program Manager, Political Law
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic's Integrity \& Compliance function is building the systems that let us scale responsibly as our products reach more people, more enterprises, and more governments. Corporate Compliance is a key pillar of that function, covering anti\-bribery and anti\-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, outside activities, the Code of Conduct, and related employee\-conduct matters.



As Senior Compliance Program Manager, you will build and run Anthropic's political law compliance program — the operating infrastructure behind our corporate PAC, corporate political giving, state and local pay\-to\-play preclearance, and the gift and ethics rules governing our interactions with public officials. As the program develops, the role may also extend to oversight of lobbying registration and reporting. You'll own the program end to end: designing the workflows, registers and controls, doing the work directly where it belongs in\-house, and directing and quality\-checking outside political law counsel and compliance vendors where we use them. You'll be the day\-to\-day compliance partner to our Policy and Government Affairs teams, working in close partnership with Policy Legal, who own the substantive legal advice, and with the rest of Corporate Compliance on the anti\-corruption side of government engagement.



Because we run lean, you may support certain workstreams in our broader corporate compliance program — gifts and hospitality, conflicts of interest, outside business activities and related day\-to\-day matters — and help design the AI\-assisted workflows that let a small team cover a large surface area.



This is a builder's role. We're looking for someone who has run political law compliance programs hands\-on, is equally comfortable doing the work and managing outside firms who do it, always knows where every preclearance request and filing stands, and can turn fifty\-state complexity into simple processes the business will actually use.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the political contributions preclearance program: intake, covered\-persons register, jurisdiction\-by\-jurisdiction pay\-to\-play screening against live and prospective public\-sector business, recordkeeping, and periodic reconciliation
* Support corporate PAC compliance operations in partnership with Policy, Finance and outside counsel — restricted\-class eligibility controls, solicitation review workflow, FEC reporting oversight, and reconciliations
* Maintain the corporate political giving log and vetting workflow for candidate, committee, 527 and c4 contributions, and integrate pay\-to\-play triggers into contract intake for public\-sector deals
* Depending on how the program is scoped, support or take on lobbying compliance oversight: keeping a consolidated view of registrations, deadlines and filing status, and working with the outside firms that prepare filings
* Manage outside political law counsel and compliance vendors supporting these workstreams — scoping, inputs, quality, timeliness and budget — and recommend over time what should sit in\-house versus outside
* Run gifts and hospitality review for events and interactions involving public officials, applying federal, state and local gift and ethics rules alongside our anti\-corruption standards; disposition routine matters and escalate edge cases
* Review and disposition conflicts of interest, outside business activity and gifts and hospitality matters across the broader corporate compliance queue; help maintain the post\-government\-employment and recusal tracker
* Build and deliver training, quick\-reference guidance and intake how\-tos for Policy, GTM and leadership; keep policies and procedures current as the footprint changes
* Serve as product owner for AI\-assisted intake, screening and case\-management workflows in your areas — define requirements, run testing, decide what is automated versus human\-reviewed, and report program metrics to leadership
* Spot legal questions early and route them to Policy Legal or outside counsel with the facts assembled; keep I\&C, Legal and outside counsel calibrated on risk

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Hands\-on ownership of political law compliance programs — corporate PAC, campaign finance, pay\-to\-play preclearance and covered\-persons tracking, lobbying registration and reporting, government gift and ethics rules — or a closely comparable multi\-jurisdiction regulatory program
* Track record building a program, not just operating one — designing preclearance or disclosure workflows, registers, filing calendars and controls from scratch or through a major redesign
* Fluent enough to do the work directly and experienced enough to manage outside counsel and compliance vendors doing it — scoping, feeding inputs, checking quality, holding deadlines
* Working fluency in the federal framework (FECA/FEC, LDA/HLOGA, House and Senate gift rules) and the shape of state and local variation; knows when a question is a legal call and hands it off cleanly
* Strong project management and cross\-functional execution with Policy/Government Affairs, Legal, Finance and executive stakeholders; clear, brief, business\-usable writing
* Sound judgment and discretion handling politically and personally sensitive information

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* 7\+ years of experience in compliance program management
* Experience in a corporate government affairs compliance function, a political law practice or compliance vendor, or a financ

jobs.title: Materials Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.
Overview:

In this role you’ll own the creation and oversight of left\-to\-right clear to build schedules to support builds. As an MPM, you will oversee manufacturing operations (production, quality, material planning) cost, schedule and deliverables during New Product Introduction (NPI), Ramp and Sustaining Phases as well as organize and oversee manufacturing (in house or Contract Manufacturer) transition from validation to ramp and production states.
Responsibilities:
* Create and deploy supply requirements to the supply base via MRP which achieves production, inventory and cost objectives. Ensure demand from all sources (production, aftermarket, engineering, etc.) is supported appropriately
* Manage safety stock levels and optimize logistical efficiency by managing EOQs
* Manage planning system parameters and master data to optimally reflect supply chain capabilities and plan supply. Deliver clear\-to\-build status, material coverage, run\-out reports and other analyses as needed to plan production and business targets. Provide data\-driven decision support to the broader organization through what\-if and scenario planning (as examples)
* Work with external suppliers to establish the appropriate delivery schedules for individual components, specifying quantity and frequency targeting on\-time delivery; coordinate with Supply Chain team and Logistics as needed
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Engineering to support material changes resulting from Change action (CAs), plan for new material and minimize obsolescence of old material
* Apply analytics and supply chain expertise to manage system parameters and meet target inventory and service level goals while minimizing costs and obsolescence
* Build and maintain operational partnerships with assigned suppliers. Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues and resolution
* Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (procurement, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.)
* Support onboarding and training of new suppliers to ensure operational excellence and compliance with Joby’s supply chain processes and policies
* Coordinate supplier ramp up and down for new product launches, ensuring suppliers deliver shipments needed to support production targets
* Manage engineering changes to minimize obsolete inventory and ensure continuous supply


Required:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or other related field, or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years related experience in materials management, production planning, material scheduling, or purchasing in a manufacturing environment
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including ability to maintain and enhance Excel\-based material shortage reports
* Strong analytical capabilities


Desired:
* Knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software, SAP enterprise system inventory management system such as SAP to Microsoft


Additional Information:

Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $73,700 \- $125,400 per year. The compensation package will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  

Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.  

Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


San Francisco, CA


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Sales \& Success


**Compensation**
----------------


* On Target Earnings (70/30 split) $100K – $150K

Individual compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. At Front, we take a market\-based approach to pay. In addition to cash compensation (base salary, which may include commissions or overtime pay where applicable), Fronteers are eligible to receive equity in the company. This resource will provide additional information on our location zone designations. If you have questions, please contact a member of our recruiting team for additional information.

  

Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed.


Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


Front's Account Management team owns a book of business — and turning that book into revenue is the job. As a Senior Account Manager, you'll run point on Front's largest, most strategic accounts: closing renewals, hunting for expansion, and negotiating your way to bigger deals every quarter. This is a quota\-carrying seat for someone who treats every account like a pipeline of upside, not a maintenance task.


You'll be paired with a Customer Success Manager who keeps the product humming, but the commercial number is yours. Win the renewal, land the upsell, close the multi\-year deal. This role is built for a closer who wants a bigger book, bigger deals, and the autonomy to run their territory like a business.


**What will you be doing?**


* Own the number for a portfolio of Front's largest strategic accounts — renewals, upsell, cross\-sell, and net revenue retention are your quota
* Run and close complex, multi\-stakeholder negotiations, from renewal terms to premium package upsells to multi\-year contracts
* Hunt for expansion inside your existing book — using usage and health signals from your CSM partner to find the next deal before the customer asks
* Build the pitch: position services and premium packages as revenue\-driving add\-ons, not afterthoughts
* Forecast like a pro — accurate, defensible pipeline and renewal forecasting that leadership can plan the business around
* Set the standard for the team — your deal strategy and negotiation playbook become what other AMs copy
* Go toe\-to\-toe cross\-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Marketing to clear blockers and close faster
* Represent the customer's voice in pricing and packaging conversations — and use it to close bigger deals

**What skills and experience do you need?**


* 5\+ years carrying a number in Account Management, Renewals, or a commercial Customer Success role in SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating quota
* Proven closer — you've run complex, multi\-stakeholder negotiations and multi\-year contracts and won
* Track record positioning and selling services or premium packages as part of the deal, not a separate ask
* Sharp with data — you use usage and health signals to build the business case and know exactly which accounts to push
* A negotiator's instincts and the relationship chops to keep the customer close while still pushing for the better deal
* Process\-driven — you build the systems and playbooks that let you run a bigger book without dropping deals
* Comfortable partnering with CSMs, Solutions Architects, or technical teams, but never confused about who owns the commercial outcome
* Fluency with AI tools and a bias toward using them to move faster, think sharper, and automate the repetitive

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**


**What we offer**


* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post\-series D \& backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
* Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
* Mental health support with Workplace Options
* Family planning support with Maven
* $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
* Wellness Days \- Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
* Winter Break \- Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

*Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *\&* *EU Privacy Notice*


Compensation Range: $100K \- $150K

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
**About** **Nooks.ai****:**
===========================


Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from *account strategy* to *prospect research* and *outreach*. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.


Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M\+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales\-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high\-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.

**About the role:**  

Location: Hybrid / 3 days Onsite – San Francisco, CA


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented and ambitious People Operations Generalist to to help build and run the People infrastructure that supports our team as we scale. You’ll own and support many of the operational programs employees interact with throughout their time at Nooks \- including HRIS, onboarding, benefits, leaves, immigration, Total Rewards administration, and employee lifecycle operations.


This role is a great fit for someone who loves making complicated things simple. You’re highly organized, operationally rigorous, and genuinely care about creating a great employee experience. You notice when something doesn’t work, dig into why, and build a better process rather than accepting unnecessary friction.


As Nooks scales, you’ll help us make sure our People operations scale with it \- without losing the speed, thoughtfulness, and employee experience that matter to us.

**What you'll do:**

* Own and develop core people operations processes, including onboarding, offboarding, benefits, compliance, and employee lifecycle management.
* Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers navigating People programs, policies, and systems.
* Help own our HRIS and broader People tech stack, including system configuration, employee data, workflows, integrations, reporting, and troubleshooting.
* Own the operational side of onboarding and ensure every new hire has a smooth experience from signed offer through their first weeks at Nooks.
* Administer benefits programs and support employees with enrollment, eligibility, qualifying life events, and benefits questions.
* Manage employee leaves and accommodations in partnership with employees, managers, vendors, and Legal as needed.
* Own the operational coordination of our immigration program in partnership with external immigration counsel.
* Point of contact for employee questions and matters related to benefits, onboarding, immigration, leaves of absence, and time off.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal labor laws \- and stay ahead of changes that impact our business and people.
* Other People or general operations responsibilities as required by the People team on an ad\-hoc basis.

**We're looking for someone who has:**

* 3\+ years of practical experience in a People or HR\-related role \- ideally in a high\-growth startup environment.
* Detail\-oriented and data\-driven mindset \- ability to identify potential areas of improvement in our operational cadence.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring processes, deadlines, and employee needs simultaneously.
* Experience owning or significantly contributing to employee onboarding and lifecycle operations.
* Working knowledge of employee leaves and core employment compliance requirements.
* Experience administering employee benefits and partnering with benefits brokers and vendors.
* System\-mindset \- look for ways to simplify, automate, document, and improve processes
* Proactivity in problem\-solving \- you don’t just spot gaps; you fill them.

**Nice to haves:**

* Knowledge of HR compliance and regulations.
* Direct involvement in scaling startups from early\-stage to larger organizational structures.
* Experience with HRIS systems, people analytics tools, and large datasets.

**You might be a great fit if:**


You care about both sides of People Operations: operational rigor and employee experience. You want the data to be right, the process to be scalable, and the employee on the other end to feel supported.


You’re excited to join a small People team where you’ll have real ownership, broad exposure, and the opportunity to build systems that will support the next stage of Nooks’ growth!

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
------------------------------------------


Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $135K

**We're looking for someone who has:**

* 6\-8\+ years of HRBP experience within a high\-growth tech environment.
* Strong manager coaching skills and the ability to build credibility with leaders at multiple levels.
* Deep experience managing employee relations and performance matters, including complex or sensitive situations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly in sensitive situations.
* Ability to recognize patterns and build scalable solutions without introducing process for process’s sake.

**Nice to haves:**

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
* Experience partnering with founders to shape people strategies that drive performance, engagement, and organizational success.
* Experience working in an international company, with a preference for experience in Ireland or London.

**You might be a great fit if:**


You’re energized by being close to the business. You want to understand how a team actually works, what its leaders are trying to accomplish, and where people or organizational challenges could get in the way.


You’re equally comfortable challenging a senior leader, coaching a first\-time manager, navigating a difficult employee situation, and stepping back to ask whether the organization itself needs to change.


Most importantly, you see People partnership as more than responding to issues: you want to help leaders build stronger organizations before those issues happen.

We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
Founded in 2018 with co\-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results.



Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor\-agnostic integrating with any API\-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest\-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it's popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security\-focused teams.



At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We're excited about what's next, and we're looking for others to join us on our journey.

***This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.***



The **Customer Success Manager** role will play a critical part in the exciting growth trajectory of Tines. As an automation platform, the more the customer automates, the more value they see. Your role will be to drive adoption and expand the usage across the customer base, ensuring that our customers realize the full potential of the platform. Alongside expansion with existing teams, you will play a crucial part in our strategy to expand outside of security teams into other functions in our clients (IT, Engineering, Operations).



You will do this by supporting our customers from onboarding to ongoing support to expansion and renewals. You will become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Tines product, helping foster champions within the customer who will identify automation opportunities across their organization. At the same time, you will provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, helping us shape the future of the product. The role will also partner closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other internal teams.


**What you will be doing:**


* Leading a first\-class onboarding experience and ensuring customer use cases and requirements are met in the specified timeline
* Translating technical customer needs to internal technical teams and delivering feedback to the Product team on new feature requests and enhancements to shape and improve the platform
* Coordinating onboarding and business reviews to evaluate performance, learn about the customers priorities, and locate new opportunities to promote expansion within existing and new teams
* Partnering with internal resources to build account plans and align customer needs with use cases to increase platform usage
* Proactively identify risks to the customer achieving their stated goals, and work with the CSM / PM teams to develop and drive a comprehensive risk mitigation plan
* Identifying issues that impact customers and/or challenges in the business and are able to provide thought leadership in finding a customer solution or assist in co\-development of process improvement, programs and/or assets
* Developing and driving a renewal plan and delivering a strategic message to analysts, management, and the C\-Suite on the value of Tines and next steps for the account
* Review account dashboards, metrics, log\-ins, and use cases to determine the health of the customer


**What you bring with you:**


* 3\+ years of experience in a technical account management, customer success, or post\-sales role at a technology company
* Experience with a SaaS solutions offering for technical teams (cybersecurity, DevOps, IT, other)
* Experience asking questions to uncover problems, locate new opportunities, and translate technical requirements to internal teams and partners
* Knowledge of API's \+ how they function


**Target Annual Earnings (salary \+ commission): $125K OTE**

  


*Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

  

***\#LI\-SW1***

  

At Tines, we're all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you're second\-guessing your application, we hope you'll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn't always easy, especially if you're thinking of a career pivot – but we're big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you've nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We'd love to hear from you.

Sales Department

**Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.


The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role.

**Multiple Locations**: United States

**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts

* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled

* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed




**Position Requirements**


* BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Netsuite/ERP, Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.title: Residential Case Manager - 815 Residential Services
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
  

HealthRIGHT 360 offers residential treatment services designed to serve individuals and families with substance use disorders and co\-occurring mental health disorders. Our program helps clients address addiction and related issues, increase skills, manage stressors, connect to supportive service, and build a foundation for lasting recovery. Residential programs run 24/7 and Individual and group therapy, family therapy, individualized case management, treatment planning, drug and alcohol counseling, Medication support services, and crisis intervention.
  
  

**Benefits and perks:**  

* HR360 offers a robust benefits package, including PTO, 15 paid holidays, commuter benefits, retirement plans, and more!
* Employees qualify for public loan forgiveness programs
* Training and professional development opportunities
* Work with mission driven, compassionate colleagues and make a difference every day in the work that you do.


**The required work schedule for this position is:**  

This is a union eligible position.
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  

The 815 Residential and Detox Program The program fully integrates substance use disorder and mental health services; beyond merely providing both services under the same roof or cross\-training staff, it adopts a model of providing effective services to the targeted needs of individuals with co\-occurring disorders. The program treats both problem types as primary and assists participants to recognize key reciprocal factors such as self\-medicating strategies; physiological and psychological changes associated with long\-term substance use; and the impact of street drugs on mental health symptoms.
  
  

The Residential Case Manager is a vital member of the treatment team, responsible for ensuring seamless service coordination for clients receiving substance use disorder (SUD) treatment within HealthRIGHT 360’s residential programs under the Drug Medi\-Cal Organized Delivery System (DMC\-ODS) in San Francisco. This role focuses on care coordination, referral and linkage, transition planning, medication management support, and interdisciplinary collaboration to support clients’ recovery and successful reintegration into the community.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Care Coordination \& Client Advocacy
  
* Conduct comprehensive assessment of case management needs and utilize information in the clients’ American Society of Addiction Medicine (ASAM) Assessment to determine and provide appropriate care coordination services.
* Support clients in obtaining and maintaining benefits including Medi\-Cal.
* Develop individualized care coordination goals for clients’ treatment plans that align with clients’ needs, preferences, and recovery goals, ensuring integration with co\-occurring mental health and medical services when applicable.
* Monitor and track clients’ progress toward care coordination goals, making adjustments to care plans based on evolving needs and treatment responses.
* Collaborate with the clients’ treatment team to ensure appropriate use of case management business passes that do not interfere with clients meeting daily treatment requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of contact relating to care coordination needs for clients, their families (when appropriate), and internal and external service providers to ensure a holistic, client\-centered approach to care. Completes all Releases of Information.


Referral \& Linkage to Support Services
  
* Facilitate linkage to internal and external community resources, social services, medical care, mental health care, and housing to support clients in accessing and utilizing services to meet their care coordination goals and support long\-term recovery.
* Facilitate linkage to lower or higher levels of care when clinically indicated.
* Coordinate warm handoffs to outpatient treatment providers, mental health professionals, and other community\-based resources to provide a supported transition out of residential care and into lower level of care.
* Advocate for clients’ rights and access to necessary services, ensuring that cultural and linguistic needs are met.


Transition Planning \& Abstinence Protection Planning Support
  
* Develop aftercare and discharge plans that prioritize continued care engagement and relapse prevention strategies.
* Transition planning and preparation for enrollment in education or employment programs after residential treatment.
* Participates in weekly reauthorization team meetings regarding ongoing medical necessity, facilitates identified linkages, and facilitates transition planning.
* Collaborate with therapists, case managers, housing navigators, and any providers involved in clients’ care to coordinate continuity of ongoing aftercare services and assist clients in successfully reintegrating into the community.
* Conduct follow\-up coordination with clients within 14 days post\-discharge to monitor successful linkage to aftercare services and encourage continued participation in treatment.

Our program helps clients address addiction and related issues, increase skills, manage stressors, connect to supportive service, and build a foundation for lasting recovery. Residential programs run 24/7 and Individual and group therapy, family therapy, individualized case management, treatment planning, drug and alcohol counseling, Medication support services, and crisis intervention.
  
  

**Benefits and perks:**  

* HR360 offers a robust benefits package, including PTO, 15 paid holidays, commuter benefits, retirement plans, and more!
* Employees qualify for public loan forgiveness programs
* Training and professional development opportunities
* Work with mission driven, compassionate colleagues and make a difference every day in the work that you do.


**The required work schedule for this position is:**  

This is a union eligible position.
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  

The 815 Residential and Detox Program The program fully integrates substance use disorder and mental health services; beyond merely providing both services under the same roof or cross\-training staff, it adopts a model of providing effective services to the targeted needs of individuals with co\-occurring disorders. The program treats both problem types as primary and assists participants to recognize key reciprocal factors such as self\-medicating strategies; physiological and psychological changes associated with long\-term substance use; and the impact of street drugs on mental health symptoms.
  
  

The Residential Case Manager is a vital member of the treatment team, responsible for ensuring seamless service coordination for clients receiving substance use disorder (SUD) treatment within HealthRIGHT 360’s residential programs under the Drug Medi\-Cal Organized Delivery System (DMC\-ODS) in San Francisco. This role focuses on care coordination, referral and linkage, transition planning, medication management support, and interdisciplinary collaboration to support clients’ recovery and successful reintegration into the community.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Care Coordination \& Client Advocacy
  
* Conduct comprehensive assessment of case management needs and utilize information in the clients’ American Society of Addiction Medicine (ASAM) Assessment to determine and provide appropriate care coordination services.
* Support clients in obtaining and maintaining benefits including Medi\-Cal.
* Develop individualized care coordination goals for clients’ treatment plans that align with clients’ needs, preferences, and recovery goals, ensuring integration with co\-occurring mental health and medical services when applicable.
* Monitor and track clients’ progress toward care coordination goals, making adjustments to care plans based on evolving needs and treatment responses.
* Collaborate with the clients’ treatment team to ensure appropriate use of case management business passes that do not interfere with clients meeting daily treatment requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of contact relating to care coordination needs for clients, their families (when appropriate), and internal and external service providers to ensure a holistic, client\-centered approach to care. Completes all Releases of Information.


Referral \& Linkage to Support Services
  
* Facilitate linkage to internal and external community resources, social services, medical care, mental health care, and housing to support clients in accessing and utilizing services to meet their care coordination goals and support long\-term recovery.
* Facilitate linkage to lower or higher levels of care when clinically indicated.
* Coordinate warm handoffs to outpatient treatment providers, mental health professionals, and other community\-based resources to provide a supported transition out of residential care and into lower level of care.
* Advocate for clients’ rights and access to necessary services, ensuring that cultural and linguistic needs are met.


Transition Planning \& Abstinence Protection Planning Support
  
* Develop aftercare and discharge plans that prioritize continued care engagement and relapse prevention strategies.
* Transition planning and preparation for enrollment in education or employment programs after residential treatment.
* Participates in weekly reauthorization team meetings regarding ongoing medical necessity, facilitates identified linkages, and facilitates transition planning.
* Collaborate with therapists, case managers, housing navigators, and any providers involved in clients’ care to coordinate continuity of ongoing aftercare services and assist clients in successfully reintegrating into the community.
* Conduct follow\-up coordination with clients within 14 days post\-discharge to monitor successful linkage to aftercare services and encourage continued participation in treatment.

**About Swords to Plowshares**

Founded in 1974, Swords to Plowshares is a community\-based not\-for\-profit organization that provides counseling and case management, employment and training, housing, and legal assistance to veterans in the San Francisco Bay Area. We promote and protect the rights of veterans through advocacy, public education, and partnerships with local, state, and national entities. Believing that war causes wounds and suffering that last beyond the battlefield, our mission is to support veterans as they navigate the challenges of post\-military life, and to prevent and end veteran homelessness through wrap\-around care and informed advocacy. To learn more about Swords to Plowshares, please visit our website at www.swords\-to\-plowshares.org.

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 11 am – 7 pm

**Employment Type:** Non\-Exempt AND Full\-Time

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**If healthcare were built today, it would look completely different**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Personalized, preventative, and easy to navigate. A health partner that helps you understand what’s happening in your body and what to do next.


That’s what we’re building at Superpower. Our ambition is to bring together testing, clinicians, and treatments into a healthcare experience people actually want to use.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re hiring an Operations Lead to build and scale the operations behind Superpower’s member experience. Your work will focus on scaling the workforce and systems needed to support a growing member base, through projects such as improving blood draw reliability, diagnostic delivery, and vendor performance.


You’ll work closely with leadership to identify the most important problems, decide how to solve them, and own implementation. That could mean improving blood draw availability, building a staffing model for increased demand, or setting up the operations for a new service.


You’ll work with member success, clinical operations, product, engineering, and external partners. We’re looking for someone who can analyze a business problem, make a sound recommendation, and get into the details of making it work.


Success means more members receiving a reliable, high\-quality experience, with service capacity, unit economics, and profitability improving as we grow. As you deliver, there is room to take on broader operational responsibility.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* **Improve blood draw operations.** Expand appointment availability, improve completion and reliability, and reduce errors. Investigate where the experience breaks down and work with providers and internal teams to fix the underlying causes.
* **Strengthen diagnostic and vendor operations.** Improve the experience for members using specialty diagnostics, from ordering through completion. Evaluate partners, establish service standards, and manage performance and costs to improve reliability and margins.
* **Build workforce capacity and efficiency.** Forecast demand, model staffing needs, and improve how work is allocated across member success and clinical operations. Build systems and use AI and automation to increase productivity while maintaining service quality.
* **Scale B2B operations.** Partner with Customer Success to build repeatable processes for employer onboarding, employee activation, and ongoing service delivery. Make responsibilities and handoffs clear as the client base grows.
* **Launch new operational capabilities.** Own the setup for new services and delivery models, such as new blood draw modalities, prescription operations, or expansion of services like virtual appointments, advanced diagnostics, or specialty referrals. Define the pilot, secure the vendors and staffing, build the workflows, and stay accountable for performance after launch.
* **Make operations more resilient.** Turn successful improvements into repeatable processes with clear ownership, documentation, and performance measures. Strengthen the existing team’s capacity and make critical work less dependent on any one person.

**You might thrive in this role if you**
----------------------------------------

* Have 5\+ years of relevant experience across operations, strategy and operations, consulting, or building a company, including at least two years in an operating role.
* Have personally built or improved a business operation, such as a service delivery process, vendor network, or workforce model. You can explain what you owned, the decisions you made, and the results.
* Are AI\-native. You know how to use AI to investigate problems, automate workflows, and scale operations.
* Think in systems. You look past one\-off fixes to understand how incentives, handoffs, tools, data, and process interact, then redesign the system so the same problem stays solved.
* Understand P\&L impact. You can connect operational decisions to revenue, gross margin, cost\-to\-serve, and profit, and prioritize work based on business impact even when you do not directly own the P\&L.
* Are highly analytical and comfortable working directly with data. You can forecast demand, model capacity and costs, size opportunities, and use operational data to decide where to invest or change the approach.
* Know how to investigate an unfamiliar process, find the underlying cause of a problem, and carry a solution through implementation and measurement.
* Can work effectively with frontline teams, technical partners, vendors, and leadership. You communicate clearly, secure decisions, and follow through on commitments.
* Move comfortably between setting direction and doing the detailed work yourself. You take responsibility for whether an operation works after it launches.
* Care about improving healthcare and understand that reliability, convenience, and clear communication shape a member’s experience.

**Why join Superpower**
-----------------------


There’s a lot here to build. You’ll work on problems that directly affect how the business grows and how members experience their healthcare.


You’ll get room to make decisions, see the consequences, and take on bigger things as you deliver. If you want to build a company of your own one day, there’s plenty here to learn by doing.

**If a particular project came to mind while reading this, we’d love to hear about it. Tell us what you built, what you personally owned, and what happened.**

**About Superpower**
====================


Superpower is a new health system on a mission to extend and enhance human life.


We started with lab testing, then data aggregation / digital twin, then an AI doctor, and now peptides.


Over the past 6 months, we have grown 10x whilst halving CAC. Now we are gearing up for hyper growth.

 **You can find more about us below:**

* superpower.com/series\-a
* Superpower Overview
* Cul

**Job Title: Office Supervisor**
**Job Location: S. Jose, CA**
**Job Type:** Full Time
  

**Your new career awaits you...**
**Job Description**  

  

We are looking to hire a front office professional that is compassionate and discrete with superb time management and record\-keeping skills. To ensure success, the office manager should be confident and professional with fantastic communication and interpersonal skills that will contribute to the efficient day\-to\-day administration of the healthcare facility. Top candidates will work comfortably under pressure while multi\-tasking in a fast\-paced environment and can effectively react to patient emergencies.  

  

**Responsibilities:**
* **Leadership:** Coach, mentor, and train front office staff to ensure office policies, procedures, customer support expectations, and compliance initiatives are met/maintained. Oversee and manage front office processes to ensure consistency and alignment with practice policies and procedures.
* **Patient Reception:** Greet patients with a warm and friendly demeanor, ensuring they feel welcomed and comfortable upon arrival. Handle patient registration, verify insurance information, and assist with any necessary paperwork.
* **Scheduling:** Manage the appointment calendar efficiently to ensure optimal scheduling of patient visits. Coordinate with the oral surgeon and clinical staff to optimize appointment availability and minimize waiting times.
* **Telephone and Email Correspondence:** Answer incoming phone calls and respond to email inquiries promptly and professionally. Provide accurate information about services, appointments and general office policies.
* **Patient Records:** Maintain and update patient records with accuracy and confidentiality. Ensure all necessary documentation is complete and organized for easy access by the clinical team.
* **Insurance:** Collaborate with patients to verify insurance coverage to include prior authorizations and pre\-determination. Assist patients in understanding their insurance benefits and financial responsibilities.
* **Office Coordination:** Assist in the coordination of administrative tasks to maintain the smooth operation of the office. This includes ordering office supplies, managing mail, and coordinating with vendors as needed.
* **Patient Care and Satisfaction:** Strive to deliver a five\-star experience with exceptional customer service to all patients, addressing their concerns and resolving any issues that may arise. Ensure a positive patient experience from check\-in to check\-out.
* **Adherence to Policies and Procedures:** Comply with all office policies, procedures, and protocols to maintain a safe and efficient working environment. Maintain confidentiality of all doctors, staff, and patient information.

**Required Qualifications:**
* High school diploma or equivalent is required.
* 5 or more years of experience as a Office Manager
* 1 or more years of experience leading teams in a medical office setting required.
* Proven background providing exceptional patient support and customer service.
* Driven, organized, and detail oriented in approach to managing responsibilities.
* Proficiency in computer software applications.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail to handle patient records, scheduling, and administrative tasks efficiently.
* Professional language and customer service mindset
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to use discretion while working with sensitive information.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and Microsoft Office skills
* Passionate about healthcare excellence.

**Schedule:**
* Monday to Friday, 8 hour shift

**Benefits:**
* 401(k) Matching
* Dental Insurance
* Health Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Referral Program

**Special Requirements:**
* Woking in\-office is an essential function to this job.
* Physical requirements include sitting, stooping, turning, standing, bending, walking, hearing, reading, writing, and keyboarding, may lift up to 25 lbs.
* This is not an all\-inclusive list of job\-related responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions. Management may require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**


Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

 **What You Will Lead and Influence**

* Architect and lead end\-to\-end D365 Finance solutions that deliver measurable outcomes for mid\-market and enterprise clients.
* Advise senior stakeholders, including CFOs and Operations leaders, to define requirements and design transformation roadmaps.
* Set solution direction and guide delivery teams to ensure projects meet scope, quality, and client expectations.
* Lead functional design, feature optimization, data integrity, and user experience improvements to maximize platform value.
* Participate in quality reviews and steer project teams through design, prototyping, and deployment phases.
* Contribute to Crowe’s methodologies, accelerators, and best practices; mentor team members; and support the growth of our D365 offering.
* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

 **Why You’ll Thrive Here**

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.
* Supportive leadership that values initiative and thought leadership.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

jobs.description:
**We’re People People. Are you?**

  

  

We’re Sonesta International Hotels—the 8th largest hotel company in the U.S. (and growing fast ).  



  

With a dynamic mix of full\-service and focused hotels across major cities, our diverse portfolio of owned, managed, and franchised properties means we’re everywhere our guests need us to be.


But here’s the thing—we’re not just in the business of hotels, we’re in the business of people. We bring service with passion, loyalty with purpose, and create experiences that genuinely connect—delivering quality, value, and memorable stays across 1,000\+ properties in eight countries (and counting).

  

  

  

**What this role is all about**

  

  

Assist in managing all aspects of front office areas, which may include but not limited to guest registration, bell services, concierge services, business center, telephone services, and guest reservations to ensure guest satisfaction and maximize hotel profitability. Adhere to all brand standards and desk merchandising. Serve as Front Office Manager in his/her absence.  

  

  

**What you’ll be doing**


* Act independently as MOD, covering morning and evening shifts.
* Supervise all front office staff including front desk, communications, uniform services and concierge.
* Offer MOD support to other unsupervised departments as needed.
* Act as Travel pass champion.
* Distribute minutes and conduct Manager’s Meeting.
* Oversee VIP arrivals.
* Perform VIP Escorts.
* Act as Lobby Ambassador
* Track and follow up on in\-house guest challenges.
* Resolve guest related issues.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement & Training Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Construction is one of the largest industries in the U.S., but also one of the least technologically advanced. Every year, firms spend over $60B on teams creating cost estimates for bids. The process relies on tedious "takeoffs"—manually measuring and counting materials from drawings.


Bobyard automates takeoffs using computer vision and NLP, cutting estimate time significantly while reducing errors. We're a small team backed by Primary, Pear, and 8VC, building software for the construction industry.

 **Position Overview**


We're hiring our first dedicated Sales Enablement \& Training Manager to build the training, tooling, and content infrastructure behind our sales org. You'll own onboarding and ramp for new AEs and SDRs, sharpen our messaging for a notoriously hard\-to\-sell buyer (skeptical, hands\-on, trade\-vertical decision makers), and make sure reps have what they need to run a consistent, effective sales process — from first call to close.


This is a high\-ownership, build\-from\-scratch role. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to translate what's working in the field into scalable playbooks, and you'll have a direct line to leadership on what's moving the needle.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build and own onboarding for every new AE and SDR, across every trade vertical we sell into
* Partner with our Sales Engineers to design and run a certification program reps have to pass before running demos or calls solo
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify skill gaps by stage of the funnel and build targeted training to close them
* Sit in on live calls and give reps specific, individual coaching — this is hands\-on, not just content
* Partner with Product on launch readiness — making sure reps can sell new features and verticals from day one
* Build and maintain trade\-specific playbooks that make it easier for new reps to sell
* Track ramp time and quota attainment by cohort, and use it to prove what's working and cut what isn't
* Own the enablement tech stack – ensuring reps are equipped and trained on the tools they use daily
* Coach managers on how to reinforce enablement content in 1:1s and deal reviews

 **What We're Looking For**

* 3\-5\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, or a related revenue role (AE/SE background a plus), ideally at a startup that's scaled quickly
* Experience building a training program from the ground up, not just maintaining an existing program
* Strong instincts for translating complex or technical product value into simple, repeatable selling language — especially for a buyer that isn't software\-native
* Comfortable with sales tooling and data (HubSpot or similar CRM; comfort with reporting/analytics a plus)
* Bonus: experience selling into construction, trades, or other traditionally offline/skeptical\-of\-software industries

 **Benefits**

* Competitive salary ($120K–$145K base), Bonus, 401K, and equity options
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus flexible PTO
* Direct impact on how the sales team grows, with ownership of the enablement function from the ground up
* Work alongside a driven team building something new in a large, underserved industry

 **SF\-based role: full\-time, in\-person in San Francisco (4 days/week)**  



We think our product stands out and the industry is ready for it. If you're excited to help us prove that out, we'd love to talk.

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $145K

* Consolidate regional project tracking information and incorporate updates into the Integrated Master Schedule.
* Prepare programmatic materials, including POM issue papers, budget exhibits, and compliance documentation.
* Develop and maintain recurring execution metric reports, including weekly fiscal updates for leadership.

* Bachelor's degree and 5\+ years of experience in program or project coordination, facility lifecycle management, facilities planning, or infrastructure analysis.
* Experience supporting technical teams, engineers, or planners in a capital investment or portfolio management environment.
* Ability to coordinate with stakeholders to gather and track schedule, budget, or planning requirements.
* Understanding of facility planning, capital investment concepts, or resource prioritization practices.

Do you want to LOVE where you work and get full training to do it?


Jacoby \& Meyers is the nation's pre\-eminent law firm protecting consumers since 1972\. We are currently seeking a smart and determined **Accounting Manager** to join our growing team. This individual will oversee the firm's full accounting function, including trust (IOLTA) accounting, case cost tracking, financial reporting, and internal controls, while partnering closely with firm leadership to support strategic decision\-making.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or related field required; CPA a plus
* 5\+ years of progressive accounting experience, with prior law firm experience strongly preferred (Personal Injury a plus)
* Strong working knowledge of trust/IOLTA accounting and legal billing practices
* Proven experience managing a full\-cycle accounting function and leading an accounting team
* Proficiency with legal practice management/accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Filevine, Litify, or similar)
* Advanced Excel skills, with experience in financial modeling and reporting
* Solid understanding of GAAP and internal controls
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross\-functionally with attorneys and staff
* Ability to thrive under pressure in a fast\-paced, high\-volume law firm environment

**What We Offer:**

* Flexible Schedules
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Pet Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company\-paid Life Insurance and AD\&D Coverage, Voluntary Life Insurance
* Short\-term and Long\-term Disability
* Employee Assistance and Travel Assistance Programs
* Paid Time Off, Paid Sick Time, Paid Holidays
* Health FSA and Dependent Care FSA
* Accident Insurance
* Cell Phone and Internet Stipend
* Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance
* Remote Positions

**About J\&M:**


Jacoby \& Meyers was founded in 1972 with the intention of making the legal system more accessible to the average person. Now, more than 50 years later, we continue to help people get the justice and compensation they deserve. Specializing in all types of accident claims, including automobile, motorcycle, bicycle, Uber/Lyft, or trucking accidents, slip and falls, dog bites, construction accidents and other wrongful conduct, the attorneys at Jacoby \& Meyers have recovered over a billion dollars for their clients' personal injury and wrongful death claims caused by the negligence of a third party.
